## Santiago · Atacama Desert · Torres del Paine

Santiago shines with the glass facades of a modern city, framed by the majestic Andes stretching endlessly from north to south. In the north, the Atacama, the driest non-polar desert on Earth and one of the oldest, reveals lunar valleys, high lagoons and geysers; in the far south, Torres del Paine National Park unfolds its mountains, glaciers, rivers, lakes and forests, crowned by three iconic granite towers.
